topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, course structure, and learning objectives for the lecture series.

topics.label: Genetic alterations, differentiation failure, and tissue architecture in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological basis of cancer as a breakdown of genetic regulation, developmental differentiation programs, and three-dimensional tissue organization.

topics.label: Pathology of invasion, metastasis, and malignant progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the clinical and histological hallmarks that distinguish contained benign tumors from locally invasive and metastatic malignancies.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and pathophysiological mechanisms of morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the formal classification of neoplasms and the physical and physiological mechanisms through which tumors cause disease and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence and comparative oncology across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate patterns of tumor incidence and common cancer types across human populations, companion animals, and multicellular taxa.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening modalities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how cancers present clinically and assess the diagnostic principles, efficacy, and limitations of population screening methods.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing housekeeping by summarizing the session's learning objectives and outlining upcoming practicals.
